items.headline: Flood Advisory issued November 18 at 2:42PM EST until November 18 at 4:45PM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Central Brevard County in east central Florida...

* WHEN...Until 445 PM EST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 242 PM EST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Melbourne, Titusville, Rockledge, Cocoa, Cocoa Beach, Satellite
Beach, Cape Canaveral, Merritt Island, Sharpes, Port Canaveral,
Port Saint John, Patrick Space Force Base, Titusville Airport,
Indian Harbour Beach, Jetty Park, Viera, Canaveral Groves,
Suntree and South Patrick Shores.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
items.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 18 at 2:35PM EST until November 22 at 7:00AM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...East to Northeast winds 20 to 30 knots with occasional
gusts to Gale force. Seas 9 to 14 feet.

* WHERE...Portions of Atlantic coastal waters.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM EST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
